format: Version numbers are MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (big redesign . new features . fixes). Every update has a name. Newest first. Bump this file to ship an update.

releases.name: The Presence Update
notes: Discord Rich Presence: show the song, artist, and live playback timeline on Strata Music (toggle it in Settings › Appearance)
Sharper automatic covers: upgrades Apple/iTunes album art to 1200x1200, skips low-res thumbnails, and grabs max-res YouTube covers when downloading
Settings polish: added the Concurrent Downloads subtitle and search entry for Discord Rich Presence

releases.name: The Studio Update
notes: Settings redesigned: Library & Tabs, Player Layout & Player Look, Visualizer & Lyrics, Appearance (Buttons, Colors, Shapes, Motion, Touch), Playback and About, with a live preview of the player and a search button to find any setting
Lyrics: three more sources (NetEase, QQ Music, Kugou) next to LRCLIB, so many more songs get timed lyrics. Choose which to use and in what order in Visualizer & Lyrics › LRC Providers
Import your own .lrc files: pick one or many (name them like "Artist - Title.lrc" to match songs automatically), or from "Wrong lyrics?" in the player for one song
Lyrics options: Sync with LRC on/off, highlight style, and where the current line sits (top, centre or bottom)
Concurrent Downloads: choose how many songs download at once, from 1 to 8
Player Layout: Compact / Normal / Roomy spacing, hide the album art, and a Rounded / Circle / Sharp play button
